value.rationale: The 32-depth table gives sharp all-length stability thresholds for an ordered-alphabet stack-sorting factor invariant on the canonical complemented period-doubling word. Multiple dyadic phase jumps and exactly one collision fiber on every boundary provide structural data for the natural problem of quantitative tortoise convergence. Unlike just extending a finite count, each row certifies infinitely many word lengths and distinguishes reverse alphabet order. The natural 1–32 range covers five binary depth scales; no general-depth law is inferred.
